elaine: Heads-up: Samir submitted resignation yesterday; final day is Fri 2024-05-10. Starting an offboard checklist here.
jamal: got it. ill pair with priya for handoff notes. can we freeze hiring on that headcount until we decide on coverage? :thinking_face:
elaine: freezing for now. People Ops will handle exit interview and COBRA notice. @michelle-payroll, can you confirm payroll timing and PTO payout?
michelle-payroll: final pay will hit the 2024-05-15 payroll run. PTO is prorated and paid per policy. need last timesheet approved by 2024-05-12 to calculate payouts.
samir: confirming ill approve timesheets today. also, ive got a YubiKey and a JetBrains seat tied to my work email  whats the return/reassign flow?
it-support: @samir please either drop hardware to People Ops or ship with the prepaid label. for JetBrains, we remove the seat from your account and vendor-ops will reassign once deprovisioned. share the exact email if it differs.
oliver-security: security note: we need to rotate any service-account keys Samir touched. @maria-eng-sre can you compile a list of service accounts and last access times by EOD 2024-05-08?
maria-eng-sre: will produce CSV with columns service_account, env, last_used and post here. ETA EOD 05/08.
jamal: need runbook capture for the inference-tuning pipeline Samir maintained. priya, can you block a few pairing sessions next week?
priya: yep, scheduled short 30m sessions 05/06-05/09; ill record and drop notes in Confluence.
elaine: benefits cutoff: coverage ends 2024-05-31. COBRA packet must be dispatched within 14 days of termination. benefits-bot will queue it, but we need Samirs preferred personal contact info.
samir: send COBRA to samir.k+exit@example.com and cc my personal. please confirm when its sent.
benefits-bot: COBRA packet queued for 2024-05-10 to samir.k+exit@example.com and hr@redwood.example.com. link: https://benefits.example.com/cobra
michelle-payroll: note on equity: vesting cutoff is end of last full month worked; equity-ops will provide final calculation.
equity-ops: well run final settlement process by 2024-05-12; confirm repos with CLA bindings for ownership handoff.
oliver-security: access plan: staged deprovision. SSO disabled 2024-05-10 18:00 UTC after final handoff call. emergency retains via ticket. we will rotate API and service keys tied to his username.
it-support: offboard steps:
```
1) Collect returned hardware (laptop RDW-4421, YubiKey)
2) Wipe device using corporate wipe: wipe.sh --enterprise
3) Update AssetDB marking RDW-4421 retired
4) Revoke SSH keys in org-keyring and remove from sudo groups
```
please confirm asset tag and drop-off timing.
samir: laptop asset tag RDW-4421. ill drop at SF front desk 05/10 morning and include YubiKey in envelope.
jamal: vendor accounts: ensure JetBrains, Datadog, and other commercial seats are unassigned and billing stop dates recorded.
vendor-ops: opened ticket JIRA-789 for JetBrains license reassign; ETA 2 business days after deprovision. Datadog revoke done upon API key rotation.
maria-eng-sre: heres the CSV snippet (pasted):
service_account,env,last_used
infra-deploy-prod,prod,2024-04-25
batch-tuner,staging,2024-05-01
metrics-pusher,prod,2024-04-30

oliver-security: well target rotating infra-deploy-prod key first. eng-sre, please confirm rotation window and any required rollback plan.
maria-eng-sre: planning rotation 05/09 16:00-17:00 UTC; will notify teams and provide rollback runbook.
jamal: reminder to capture any open PRs or ownership links in repository metadata so code reviews dont stall. Samir, can you list any active PRs?
samir: currently two open PRs in tune-service and one patch in infra-templates. ill mark reviewers and link notes in PR descriptions.
elaine: exit interview: propose Zoom on 05/10 afternoon. Samir, verbal or written?
samir: Zoom works. ill be brief and candid. thanks everyone  happy to help pass context.
elaine: final People Ops checklist to close: - timesheet approval confirmed - COBRA packet sent - assets returned and logged - SSO disabled post-handoff - service-account rotations complete - payroll and PTO payout confirmed
elaine: ill post closure once were green on all. :white_check_mark:
